what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Brazil in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 54559 Brazilian asylum seekers in the United States, 81.8% of all asylum seekers from Brazil.
Refugees from Brazil, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Canada and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Brazil, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 573 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 70508, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
